title: Senior Manager, Platform Management
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
 The Community You Will Join:
 At Airbnb, we maintain and extend a world-class payments platform that is the engine of commerce and trust for our global community. This platform currently supports 220 countries and over 65 currencies, connecting dozens of payment providers and processing billions of dollars annually. To enable and support growth of the marketplace, we continually innovate unique ways for guests to pay for stays and experiences that are memorable and in many cases life changing. Whether it's providing accepting relevant forms of payments, breaking payments into more manageable parts, or combining payments for several individuals seeking to travel and share together, Airbnb strives to make paying trips as simple as possible, while protecting our guests and hosts with security and assurances we have their backs every step of the way.
 The Difference You Will Make:
 Within the payment organization, the platform team comprises individuals that manage our products and experiences related to checkout, payment methods, risk, compliance, and hosts payouts. We are seeking a strong Senior Platform leader to manage all aspects of our guest payment capabilities and experiences. This includes enabling new global and local payment methods, onboarding and validating methods with our processing partners, managing post transaction interactions such as refunds and transaction reporting, and finally creating and expanding our growing portfolio of installments and financing solutions to help pay for trips and trip related services. This role is a key leadership position within the platform product organization and…

title: Principal Consultant (Senior Manager) - Trade & Transaction Reporting
description:
Principal Consultant (Senior Manager) – Trade & Transaction Reporting

Location: London or Edinburgh (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime | Type: Permanent

Shape the future of global regulatory reporting transformation

The Role

Capco is seeking a Principal Consultant (Senior Manager) to join our Trade & Transaction Reporting capability within the Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime (FRRF) practice. This role is suited to someone with strong regulatory reporting expertise and proven experience delivering complex, multi-jurisdictional transformation programmes. You'll work with leading global financial institutions to implement regulatory change, strengthen reporting controls, and optimise reporting operating models across regimes including EMIR Refit, MiFIR, SFTR, CFTC, MAS, and HKMA. You'll also leverage approved AI tools and AI-enabled ways of working to improve analysis, accelerate delivery, and enhance reporting quality while applying responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight.

title: Principal Consultant (Senior Manager) - Operational Resilience & Cyber
description:
Principal Consultant (Senior Manager) – Operational Resilience & Cyber Risk

Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime | Type: Permanent

Build resilience where it matters most across cyber, technology, and third-party risk

The Role

Capco is seeking experienced Principal Consultants in Operational Resilience and Cyber Risk to join our growing Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime (FRRF) capability. In this senior role, you'll lead complex client engagements across financial services and energy, advising on regulatory expectations such as PRA and DORA while driving the design and implementation of robust resilience frameworks. You'll play a key role in shaping client strategy, leading transformation programmes, and contributing to capability growth. You'll also leverage approved AI tools and AI-enabled ways of working to enhance analysis, accelerate insight generation, and improve delivery while applying responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight.

What You'll Do

  • Lead operational resilience assessments, scenario testing, and control implementation programmes, identifying opportunities to leverage AI-enabled workflows and automation to strengthen resilience outcomes.
